product_family: Low-code internal app builder platform; sub-products include Retool Cloud (multi-tenant SaaS), Retool Self-Hosted (VPC or on-premises), Retool Database (managed hosted DB), Retool Workflows (automation), Retool AI/AppGen (AI-powered app generation), and Retool Mobile Apps

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type 2 listed as 'Certified' on Retool Trust Center (powered by SafeBase). Security practices page states: 'Retool will align with prevailing industry standards such as SOC 2 Type 2, or any successor or superseding standard.' Full report downloadable via NDA/login.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 listed as 'Certified' on Retool Trust Center (powered by SafeBase). Certificate downloadable via NDA/login.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR listed as 'Compliant' on Retool Trust Center. DPA available to all plan customers, incorporating EEA SCCs (Controller-to-Processor and Processor-to-Processor modules), UK International Data Transfer Addendum, and Swiss SCCs. Legal basis for each processing activity documented in privacy policy.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: CCPA listed as 'Compliant' on Retool Trust Center. California Privacy Rights section included in privacy policy with opt-out and deletion rights.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Retool MSA explicitly states: 'Customer acknowledges that Retool is not a Business Associate or subcontractor (as those terms are defined in the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act).' Cloud platform directs customers: 'Customer should not submit, collect or use any protected health information to the Retool Cloud Platform.' Retool does not sign BAAs for cloud deployments. Note: multiple third-party profiles incorrectly list Retool as HIPAA Compliant; this conflicts with Retool's own legal documentation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of FedRAMP authorization on retool.com, trust.retool.com, or the public FedRAMP marketplace. Not listed in Retool trust center overview alongside SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Nudge Security lists 'FedRAMP: Compliant' but this cannot be confirmed from any Retool-domain source.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of PCI DSS certification on retool.com, trust.retool.com, or docs.retool.com. Not listed in Retool trust center overview. Third-party profile (Nudge Security) shows 'PCI DSS: Compliant' but this cannot be confirmed from any Retool-domain source.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of CSA STAR certification on retool.com or trust.retool.com. Not listed in Retool trust center overview. Third-party profile (Nudge Security) shows 'CSA STAR Level 1: Compliant' but this cannot be confirmed from any Retool-domain source.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 AI governance certification on retool.com or trust.retool.com.

privacy.ai_training_note: Retool AI Terms state: 'Retool does not currently use Customer Materials or AI Output to train or fine-tune its own artificial intelligence models or algorithms.' If Retool ever changes this, it must provide advance written notice and a meaningful opt-out opportunity before any such use begins. Additionally, 'Retool will maintain contractual agreements with the providers of Retool-Managed Models that prohibit such providers from using Customer Materials or AI Output for their own model training or fine-tuning purposes.' No current training on customer data; LLM providers contractually prohibited from doing so as well.
privacy.data_region: AWS US-East by default; Enterprise plan offers EU data residency option. Self-hosted customers control their own region entirely.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS using latest recommended secure cipher suites; continuously monitored and updated for new cryptographic weaknesses

security.name: MFA / 2FA
security.value: Supported; administrators can enforce team-wide 2FA; 2FA required for all production server access

security.name: SSO
security.value: Google, Microsoft, Okta, and other SAML/OIDC providers supported

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: Detailed audit logs for administrators on Business and Enterprise plans; every sign-in logged with device type and IP address

security.name: Access control
security.value: RBAC with column-level data control; remote user disabling on demand; administrator-managed permission tiers

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Active program at retool.com/vulnerability-reporting; external security firms perform regular audits; continuous automated hybrid scanning

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Regular external audits by independent security firms; pentest report available via trust center (NDA required)

security.name: Data backup
security.value: Daily automated backups with 7-day retention; tested at least every 90 days; multi-region redundancy within AWS; hard delete within 24h of admin request, backups purged within 30 days

security.name: Personnel security
security.value: Background checks on all employees before employment; privacy and security training during onboarding and on an ongoing basis

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Security incident management policies in place; impacted customers notified without undue delay; 24/7 on-call operations team

security.name: Infrastructure hosting
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS); fault-tolerant architecture; network segmentation; AWS security groups; real-time intrusion monitoring

security.name: Recent CVEs
security.value: CVE-2025-29774 and CVE-2025-29775 (SAML authentication); CVE-2025-47424 (self-hosted deployments) - all documented in trust center with remediation guidance

products.name: Retool Cloud
products.data_scope: Multi-tenant AWS-hosted; Retool proxies queries to customer data sources server-side but does not store Customer Data unless Retool Database is used; query/workflow caching is optional and can be disabled
products.notes: Not suitable for HIPAA workloads on cloud (Retool disclaims Business Associate status). SOC 2 T2 and ISO 27001:2022 apply. Pre-signed DPA available.

products.name: Retool Self-Hosted
products.data_scope: Customer controls all infrastructure; no Retool personnel have technical or logical access to Customer Data; only usage metadata (not Customer Data) is shared with Retool
products.notes: Most suitable for regulated industries or customers requiring data sovereignty. Retool provides daily-updated Debian base image with latest security patches. Retool still does not sign BAAs even for self-hosted.

products.name: Retool AI / AppGen
products.data_scope: Prompts and generated output collected; customer controls which model provider receives data; governed by Retool AI Terms
products.notes: No Retool training on customer data; LLM providers contractually prohibited from training on customer data. If Retool's policy changes, advance notice and opt-out are required.

products.name: Retool Database
products.data_scope: Customer Data stored by Retool in AWS; encryption at rest and in transit; subject to SOC 2 T2 and ISO 27001 controls
products.notes: Hard delete within 24h of admin-initiated request; backup purge within 30 days. Not suitable for PHI storage.

products.name: Retool Workflows
products.data_scope: If using Retool-managed Temporal cluster, only orchestration metadata (workflow IDs, encrypted block names, user IDs, host and domain) shared with Temporal Technologies; Customer Data itself is not stored by Temporal
products.notes: Self-hosted Workflows option avoids Temporal data sharing entirely. Sub-processor list published on Retool docs site.

compare.pricing_model: Free tier + Team (~$10/user/mo) + Business (~$50/user/mo) + Enterprise (custom). Audit logging and RBAC gated to Business/Enterprise.
compare.data_residency: US-East on AWS by default; EU data residency available on Enterprise plan; self-hosted customers choose their own region

flags: Multiple third-party profiles (Nudge Security, some review sites) list Retool as HIPAA Compliant, but Retool's own MSA explicitly states it is not a HIPAA Business Associate and advises against submitting PHI to the cloud platform. Retool does not sign BAAs.
Third-party profiles (Nudge Security) list FedRAMP and PCI DSS as compliant, but neither appears in Retool's own trust center overview or any retool.com documentation.
Nudge Security lists 'CSA STAR Level 1: Compliant' but no Retool-domain evidence confirms this.

Trust center documents gated: SOC 2 Type 2 report, ISO 27001 certificate, and pentest report are confirmed to exist but require NDA/login at trust.retool.com to access. This is standard enterprise practice.

CVE risk for self-hosted deployments: CVE-2025-29774 and CVE-2025-29775 (SAML auth) and CVE-2025-47424 (self-hosted) disclosed in 2025. Enterprise buyers should confirm their Retool version is patched.

AI Terms carve-out in MSA is benign: the MSA language 'except as expressly set forth in the AI Terms' is resolved by the AI Terms themselves; the carve-out refers only to a future opt-out scenario requiring advance written notice, not a current AI training exception.
